controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to PSV-4210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-4210 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 6 August 2025 a planned assurance activity of PSV-4210 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the in-service inspection of pressure equipment not effective.
